note: Teardowns from tipofthebanana.com/sitemap.xml plus original standalone @TipOfTheBanana X notes from Sep 5, 2026 through Nov 14, 2026 (America/New_York). Replies, reposts, pure promos, and chit-chat were left out. Findings are taken from public post text. Official site tags used only when clearly applicable; otherwise tags may be blank.

entries.title: HoneyBaked Ham isn't baked, and the glaze has more paprika in it than honey
entries.finding: HoneyBaked Ham isn't baked, and the glaze has more paprika in it than honey.

entries.title: Costco bakes its pumpkin pies in the store that sells them
entries.finding: Costco bakes its pumpkin pies in the store that sells them.

entries.title: Pillsbury refrigerated pie crust is made with lard
entries.finding: Pillsbury refrigerated pie crust is made with lard.

entries.title: Campbell's Cream of Mushroom has more salt than cream
entries.finding: Campbell's Cream of Mushroom has more salt than cream.

entries.title: One Mexican company bakes Sara Lee bread, Thomas' English muffins and Entenmann's
entries.finding: One Mexican company bakes Sara Lee bread, Thomas' English muffins and Entenmann's: Grupo Bimbo, based in Mexico City.

entries.title: The dull side of your aluminum foil was rolled against another sheet of foil
entries.finding: The dull side of your aluminum foil was rolled against another sheet of foil.

entries.title: The two bottles of vanilla share one molecule, and you pay for everything else
entries.finding: Both pure extract and imitation get their smell from vanillin; a 2 oz pure bottle cost $6.99 and an 8 oz store-brand imitation $1.75 this week, about 16 times as much per ounce for pure.

entries.title: The short in shortbread is what the butter does to the flour
entries.finding: Walkers shortbread fingers have 4 ingredients (wheat flour, butter, sugar, salt); UK packs put butter at more than 30% of the recipe, and the US box gives no percentage.

entries.title: Chick-fil-A owns a lemon juice plant
entries.finding: Chick-fil-A's wholly owned subsidiary Bay Center Foods in Valencia, California supplies the lemon juice for the lemonade at restaurants chainwide.

entries.title: Imitation vanilla beat pure extract in an America's Test Kitchen tasting
entries.finding: America's Test Kitchen tasted vanillas stirred into pudding and frosting, and an imitation came out on top with a pure extract close behind; it won even where the vanilla wasn't cooked.

entries.title: Craisins are what is left after a cranberry is juiced
entries.finding: Ocean Spray slices frozen cranberries and an inclined screw washes the juice out against a stream of water; the juice becomes a drink and the leftover berry pieces move on to a second screw.

entries.title: Most instant coffee was already brewed before it went in the jar
entries.finding: The plant brews a very strong batch of coffee the same basic way as at home, hot water through ground roasted coffee, and then removes the water.

entries.title: Reddi-wip isn't whipped until you press the nozzle
entries.finding: The can is filled with liquid cream and nitrous oxide gas under pressure, and the gas dissolves into the cream, especially the fat; pressing the nozzle drops the pressure.

entries.title: One company makes Red Baron, Freschetta, Tony's, Mrs. Smith's and Edwards
entries.finding: Schwan's Company makes Red Baron, Freschetta and Tony's pizza and Mrs. Smith's and Edwards pies, and says Red Baron is the No. 1 frozen pizza brand in the US.

entries.title: Martinelli's sparkling cider is apple juice with bubbles in it
entries.finding: The ingredients are pasteurized 100% carbonated apple juice from US grown fresh apples and vitamin C, and the bottle says it contains no water, alcohol or sweeteners.

entries.title: Beef labeled Product of USA now has to come from cattle born here
entries.finding: Since January 1, beef labeled Product of USA has to come from cattle born in the US; before that, imported meat processed at a US plant could carry the claim.

entries.title: 7-Eleven's Japan and Hawaii egg salad sandwiches have very different labels
entries.finding: The Japan sandwich lists 5 ingredients and the Hawaii one lists more than 30, and Warabeya made both; the length is mostly label law.

entries.title: Toblerone no longer has the Matterhorn on the box
entries.finding: The mountain came off in 2023, when Mondelez moved part of Toblerone's production from Bern, Switzerland to Bratislava, Slovakia.

entries.title: Green Giant's canner sells most of its food under other names
entries.finding: Seneca Foods, which cans Green Giant, says about 15% of its packaged food is sold under its own brands; the other 85% goes out as store brands, food service, contract packing and overseas.

entries.title: Pourable tallow has had its hard fat separated out
entries.finding: Tallow that pours at room temperature has had its hard fat removed through fractionation; beef tallow is about half saturated fat, mostly palmitic and stearic.

entries.title: Baked Lay's aren't sliced potatoes
entries.finding: The first ingredient in Baked Lay's is dried potatoes, unlike classic Lay's where each chip is a slice of potato.

entries.title: The Cheesecake Factory's cheesecake isn't made at the restaurant
entries.finding: The company owns 2 bakeries, in Calabasas Hills, California and Rocky Mount, North Carolina, that make about 60 kinds of cheesecake and other baked desserts.

entries.title: Costco owns the plants that make its food court hot dog
entries.finding: Costco owns the plants that make its food court hot dog. The combo began in the 1980s as a Hebrew National frank sold from a cart at a Price Club warehouse in San Diego.

entries.title: Jell-O instant pudding sets in cold milk with no eggs and no cooking
entries.finding: Jell-O instant pudding sets in cold milk with no eggs and no cooking. The instant mix skips the heating step because the starch was already cooked and dried before it went in the box.

entries.title: Real Vanilla is pollinated by hand, one flower at a time
entries.finding: Real Vanilla is pollinated by hand, one flower at a time. The vanilla orchid has almost no natural pollinators, and even in its home range only 1 to 5% of the flowers get pollinated on their own.

entries.title: Everything about your apple is managed except its price
entries.finding: A patented, trademarked apple licensed to one state's growers went from $72.80 a box to about $28. The apple anyone may plant still brings the highest shipping-point price.

entries.title: Unless they're organic, your grapes were fumigated with sulfur dioxide after picking
entries.finding: Unless they're organic, your grapes were fumigated with sulfur dioxide after picking. California grows 99% of US table grapes and the standard practice is to gas them right after packing, then about once a week in cold storage.

entries.title: The color of your egg yolk can be picked off a numbered fan
entries.finding: The color of your egg yolk can be picked off a numbered fan. The YolkFan has 16 blades, each a shade of yolk from pale yellow to deep orange; Roche made the first one in 1956 with 12 shades.

entries.title: There's no butter in Pillsbury's "buttery" crescent rolls
entries.finding: There's no butter in Pillsbury's "buttery" crescent rolls. The main fat is a vegetable shortening made from soybean oil, hydrogenated palm oil and fractionated palm oil.

entries.title: Fish sticks are cut from a frozen block of fish
entries.finding: Fish sticks are cut from a frozen block of fish. Skinless fillets are frozen under pressure into a solid rectangle; USDA's spec puts each pollock block at about 16.5 pounds.

entries.title: The first Cheerios were shot out of a gun
entries.finding: The first Cheerios were shot out of a gun. General Mills calls it a puffing gun: pellets of cooked oat dough are heated in a sealed chamber until pressure builds, then released all at once.

entries.title: Dairy Queen's soft serve doesn't meet the FDA standard for ice cream
entries.finding: Dairy Queen's soft serve doesn't meet the FDA standard for ice cream. The FDA says ice cream has to be at least 10% milkfat; DQ's FAQ said its soft serve has 5%.

entries.title: A Chocolate Chip Clif Bar has the same calories as a Snickers
entries.finding: A Chocolate Chip Clif Bar has the same calories as a Snickers. Both labels say 250.

entries.title: MSG is made by feeding sugar to a soil bacterium
entries.finding: MSG is made by feeding sugar to a soil bacterium. At Ajinomoto's plant in Eddyville, Iowa, the sugar is glucose, and the company says it comes from Iowa corn.

entries.title: One company has made mozzarella for Pizza Hut, Domino's and Papa John's
entries.finding: One company has made mozzarella for Pizza Hut, Domino's and Papa John's. It's Leprino Foods in Denver.

entries.title: Nestlé puts ground-up Kit Kats in the filling of Kit Kats
entries.finding: Nestlé puts ground-up Kit Kats in the filling of Kit Kats. The plant calls the broken bars rework.

entries.title: The oil in a cashew shell causes a rash like poison ivy
entries.finding: The oil in a cashew shell causes a rash like poison ivy. Cashews and poison ivy are in the same plant family.

entries.title: USDA has 8 grades of beef
entries.finding: USDA has 8 grades of beef. Your grocery store usually only tells you about 3.

entries.title: King Arthur prints 11.7% protein on the front of its all-purpose flour
entries.finding: King Arthur prints 11.7% protein on the front of its all-purpose flour. Protein is what forms gluten when flour gets wet and mixed, so a higher protein flour makes chewier bread.

entries.title: Panera Bread is switching to bread made by outside bakers
entries.finding: Panera Bread is switching to bread made by outside bakers. In April 2025 it said it would close its remaining 9 plants within about 2 years.

entries.title: Your Waffle House hashbrowns start as dried potato in a carton
entries.finding: Your Waffle House hashbrowns start as dried potato in a carton. Waffle House's site names its hashbrown supplier, Basic American Foods.

entries.title: Most of the vitamin C the US imports comes from China
entries.finding: Most of the vitamin C the US imports comes from China. In 2025 it was 88% by weight, about 95 million pounds.

entries.title: Stove Top Turkey Stuffing has more corn syrup than turkey
entries.finding: Stove Top Turkey Stuffing has more corn syrup than turkey. The first two ingredients are enriched flour and high fructose corn syrup.

entries.title: Whole Foods 365 Organic Seasoned Croutons list organic cane sugar
entries.finding: Whole Foods 365 Organic Seasoned Croutons list organic cane sugar. The nutrition panel says 0g added sugars.

entries.title: Your Starbucks egg bites were cooked before they reached the store
entries.finding: Your Starbucks egg bites were cooked before they reached the store. Starbucks launched them in 2017 and said it created them with Cuisine Solutions, a company that specializes in sous vide.

entries.title: Most canned tuna is cooked twice before you open it
entries.finding: Most canned tuna is cooked twice before you open it. StarKist laid out the process at its American Samoa plant in a 2019 permit filing with the EPA.

entries.title: On November 9th the FDA dropped methylene chloride from the solvents allowed in fruit stamping ink
entries.finding: On November 9th the FDA dropped methylene chloride from the solvents allowed in fruit stamping ink. It's still allowed in your decaf.

entries.title: Snapple Peach Tea has no peach on the ingredient list
entries.finding: Snapple Peach Tea has no peach on the ingredient list. It reads filtered water, sugar, citric acid, tea and natural flavors, with the tea listed after the citric acid.

entries.title: An 11.5 oz can of V8 has 40% of your day's sodium
entries.finding: An 11.5 oz can of V8 has 40% of your day's sodium. That's 920 mg, more than twice the 400 mg in a large order of McDonald's fries.

entries.title: King's Hawaiian rolls are baked in Georgia and California, not Hawaii
entries.finding: King's Hawaiian rolls are baked in Georgia and California, not Hawaii. The company's largest bakery is in Oakwood, Georgia.

entries.title: Your turkey's pop-up timer is a spring and a plug that melts
entries.finding: Your turkey's pop-up timer is a spring and a plug that melts. The plug holds the stem down until the meat gets hot enough to soften it.

entries.title: A lot of precooked bacon in the US is cooked in a microwave
entries.finding: A lot of precooked bacon in the US is cooked in a microwave. The slices ride a conveyor belt through a row of microwave ovens.

entries.title: In-N-Out makes its own hamburger patties, in its own plants
entries.finding: In-N-Out makes its own hamburger patties, in its own plants. The company buys whole chucks, takes the bones out, grinds the meat and forms the patties there.

entries.title: Your Thanksgiving turkey is priced below wholesale on purpose
entries.finding: Grocers advertised frozen turkeys at $1.19 a pound while wholesale was $1.81.

entries.title: Your can of Bruce's Yams is sweet potatoes
entries.finding: Your can of Bruce's Yams is sweet potatoes. The front says Yams in big letters and Cut Sweet Potatoes in Syrup under it.

entries.title: A carton of USDA graded eggs can be 7 weeks old on its sell-by date
entries.finding: A carton of USDA graded eggs can be 7 weeks old on its sell-by date. Eggs that carry the USDA grade shield have to be eggs of current production when they're packed, which federal rules define as no more than 21 days old.

entries.title: Frozen whole turkey stocks just hit the lowest September on record
entries.finding: Frozen whole turkey stocks just hit the lowest September on record. USDA counted 195.8 million pounds of whole turkeys in cold storage on September 30.

entries.title: Goodles gets its 14 g of protein by stirring protein powder into the pasta
entries.finding: Goodles gets its 14 g of protein by stirring protein powder into the pasta.

entries.title: Bagged apple slices can be 3 weeks old
entries.finding: Bagged apple slices can be 3 weeks old. Most apples you cut at home start browning within minutes.

entries.title: Nearly every grocery store turkey is one breed, and it can't mate
entries.finding: Nearly every grocery store turkey is one breed, and it can't mate. The commercial bird is the Broad Breasted White.

entries.title: Your Domino's dough was made at a plant and trucked in
entries.finding: Your Domino's dough was made at a plant and trucked in. The store stretches and bakes it. Domino's runs 22 dough manufacturing and supply chain centers in the US.

entries.title: IHOP's omelettes have pancake batter in them
entries.finding: IHOP's omelettes have pancake batter in them. The omelettes are marked as containing wheat and gluten because they're made with a splash of buttermilk pancake batter.

entries.title: The McRib is mostly pork shoulder pressed into the shape of ribs
entries.finding: The McRib is mostly pork shoulder pressed into the shape of ribs.

entries.title: Your white sugar could have been filtered through charred cattle bones
entries.finding: Your white sugar could have been filtered through charred cattle bones. The label won’t tell you easily.

entries.title: The sushi counter at your grocery store usually isn't run by the grocery store
entries.finding: The sushi counter at your grocery store usually isn't run by the grocery store. AFC lists 3,984 counters in US supermarkets on its store locator.

entries.title: The vitamin D3 added to milk is usually made from sheep's wool
entries.finding: The vitamin D3 added to milk is usually made from sheep's wool. The NIH's fact sheet on vitamin D says D3 is "typically produced with irradiation of 7-dehydrocholesterol from lanolin obtained from the wool of sheep." Lanolin is the grease in wool.

entries.title: Wendy's chili was put on the menu to use up leftover hamburger
entries.finding: Wendy's chili was put on the menu to use up leftover hamburger.

entries.title: A pack labeled ground turkey can include the skin
entries.finding: A pack labeled ground turkey can include the skin. A pack labeled ground turkey meat can't.

entries.title: Burger King fries are coated in a batter. McDonald's fries aren't
entries.finding: Burger King fries are coated in a batter. McDonald's fries aren't.

entries.title: Taco Bell's seasoned beef has cellulose, oats and cocoa in the seasoning
entries.finding: Taco Bell's seasoned beef has cellulose, oats and cocoa in the seasoning.

entries.title: Costco makes slightly more from membership fees than it does from selling the merchandise
entries.finding: Costco makes slightly more from membership fees than it does from selling the merchandise.

entries.title: Egg Beaters Original is 99% egg whites, colored yellow
entries.finding: Egg Beaters Original is 99% egg whites, colored yellow. The carton reads egg white (99%).

entries.title: Much of the L-cysteine in bread dough has been made from feathers and hair
entries.finding: Much of the L-cysteine in bread dough has been made from feathers and hair.

entries.title: A packaged hamburger bun can have more alcohol by weight than a non-alcoholic beer
entries.finding: A packaged hamburger bun can have more alcohol by weight than a non-alcoholic beer. Researchers in Germany measured packaged burger rolls at 1.28 g of ethanol per 100 g in a 2016 study.

entries.title: Chick-fil-A fries its chicken in peanut oil
entries.finding: Chick-fil-A fries its chicken in peanut oil. Federal law says that oil isn't a peanut allergen.

entries.title: Costco often sells your groceries before it pays for them
entries.finding: What Costco's 10-K says about paying suppliers, and how to find who made a Kirkland Signature product.

entries.title: Ham has 4 legal names
entries.finding: Ham has 4 legal names. Each one tells you how much water is in it.

entries.title: Nerds Gummy Clusters are Ferrara's best selling candy
entries.finding: Nerds Gummy Clusters are Ferrara's best selling candy. The first 3 ingredients are 3 kinds of sugar.

entries.title: Reese's cups were made with Hershey's chocolate for 35 years before Hershey owned them
entries.finding: Reese's cups were made with Hershey's chocolate for 35 years before Hershey owned them. Harry Reese started making them around 1928 in Hershey, Pennsylvania, coating them by hand on marble slabs with chocolate Hershey supplied.

entries.title: The jelly bean in your candy bag took about a week to make
entries.finding: The jelly bean in your candy bag took about a week to make. The center starts as a cooked mix of sugar, water, cornstarch and corn syrup.

entries.title: A Butterfinger is under 2% cocoa
entries.finding: A Butterfinger is under 2% cocoa. The brown coating is palm kernel oil, palm oil and sugar.

entries.title: Halloween could be the Super Bowl of eating bugs
entries.finding: Halloween could be the Super Bowl of eating bugs. There are bugs in candy, but not all are there on purpose.

entries.title: Hershey's Miniatures are sold as an assortment of chocolate bars
entries.finding: Hershey's Miniatures are sold as an assortment of chocolate bars. 2 of the 4 are chocolate under an FDA standard.

entries.title: An 8 oz bag of Sour Patch Kids is 192 g of sugar
entries.finding: An 8 oz bag of Sour Patch Kids is 192 g of sugar. The bag weighs 227 g.

entries.title: Flavored coffee is sprayed with flavoring after roasting
entries.finding: Flavored coffee is sprayed with flavoring after roasting. The solvent that carries the flavor is not listed on the ingredient statement.

entries.title: Hot Tamales have no cinnamon in them
entries.finding: Hot Tamales have no cinnamon in them. The box says cinnamon flavored, and the heat is artificial flavor.

entries.title: Reese's Pieces have no chocolate in them
entries.finding: Reese's Pieces have no chocolate in them. The peanuts had their oil pressed out and a cheaper fat put back in.

entries.title: The chicken tray says up to 5% retained water
entries.finding: The chicken tray says up to 5% retained water. That water came from the chill tank.

entries.title: The fried chicken in a Hungry-Man dinner has soy in it
entries.finding: The fried chicken in a Hungry-Man dinner has soy in it. One tray is 1,270 mg of sodium.

entries.title: Modified food starch is starch that was treated with a chemical
entries.finding: Modified food starch is starch that was treated with a chemical. The label doesn't say which one.

entries.title: The hard boiled eggs at the hotel breakfast weren't boiled there
entries.finding: The hard boiled eggs at the hotel breakfast weren't boiled there. They came peeled, in brine.

entries.title: The pork chops at the meat counter were injected with solution
entries.finding: The pork chops at the meat counter were injected with solution. The tray reads up to 12% solution of water, salt and sodium phosphate.

entries.title: McDonald's uses 3 different eggs
entries.finding: McDonald's uses 3 different eggs. Only 1 of them is cracked in the restaurant.

entries.title: The citric acid in your food is grown on a black mold
entries.finding: The citric acid in your food is grown on a black mold. Pfizer figured out how to mass produce it and it's how Pfizer learned to make penicillin.

entries.title: Veggie Straws are potato starch
entries.finding: Veggie Straws are potato starch. The vegetables are powders, and most of them are there for color.

entries.title: Clabber Girl baking powder has aluminum in it
entries.finding: Clabber Girl baking powder has aluminum in it. So do most of the store brands next to it.

entries.title: Mission flour tortillas have 11 ingredients
entries.finding: Mission flour tortillas have 11 ingredients. A tortilla needs 4, flour, water, fat and salt.

entries.title: Skinless hot dogs had a skin
entries.finding: Skinless hot dogs had a skin. The plant peeled it off.

entries.title: The bag says no added nitrites. The same bag in Britain says sodium nitrite.
entries.finding: The bag says no added nitrites. The same bag in Britain says sodium nitrite.

entries.title: Great Value frozen shrimp has 3 ingredients
entries.finding: Great Value frozen shrimp has 3 ingredients. Shrimp, salt and sodium tripolyphosphate.

entries.title: Skittles in the UK are colored with beetroot and turmeric
entries.finding: Skittles in the UK are colored with beetroot and turmeric. Skittles in the US are colored with Red 40, Yellow 5 and Yellow 6.

entries.title: The scrambled eggs at a hotel breakfast are 19% water, and they're dyed
entries.finding: The scrambled eggs at a hotel breakfast are 19% water, and they're dyed. A lot of hotels and cafeterias pour them from a carton of Papetti's Breakfast Blend.

entries.title: Jack Link's beef jerky says no added nitrites on the bag
entries.finding: Jack Link's beef jerky says no added nitrites on the bag. The asterisk under it says except those from cultured celery extract.

entries.title: Movie theater popcorn is yellow before any butter goes on it
entries.finding: Movie theater popcorn is yellow before any butter goes on it. The color is in the salt.

entries.title: The sausage gravy mix sold to restaurants has no sausage in it
entries.finding: The sausage gravy mix sold to restaurants has no sausage in it. It starts with maltodextrin.

entries.title: If you rinse your rice, you're washing the vitamins down the drain
entries.finding: If you rinse your rice, you're washing the vitamins down the drain. Look at a bag of Mahatma or Carolina.

entries.title: The chicken in Costco's chicken salad was injected before it was ever a salad
entries.finding: The chicken in Costco's chicken salad was injected before it was ever a salad. The tub label says so.

entries.title: The made-from-scratch crust on a Marie Callender's pot pie has no butter in it
entries.finding: The made-from-scratch crust on a Marie Callender's pot pie has no butter in it. It's soybean oil, and the gold color is caramel color.

entries.title: A chicken nugget can legally be 30% breading
entries.finding: A chicken nugget can legally be 30% breading. That's a USDA limit.

entries.title: Froot Loops in Canada are colored with carrot, watermelon and blueberry juice
entries.finding: Froot Loops in Canada are colored with carrot, watermelon and blueberry juice. The US box is colored with Red 40, Yellow 5, Blue 1 and Yellow 6.

entries.title: Taco Bell's nacho cheese sauce has no cheese in it
entries.finding: Taco Bell's nacho cheese sauce has no cheese in it. The list starts with nonfat milk and cheese whey.

entries.title: Crumbl’s website has a full ingredient list for every cookie
entries.finding: Crumbl’s website has a full ingredient list for every cookie. It just doesn’t show it to you.

entries.title: Most decaf coffee is made with methylene chloride
entries.finding: Most decaf coffee is made with methylene chloride. It's the solvent that used to be in paint stripper.

entries.title: The USDA grade on a steak is a marbling score from one slice of the animal
entries.finding: The USDA grade on a steak is a marbling score from one slice of the animal. It isn't a safety inspection.

entries.title: A bowl of Raisin Bran has more sugar in it than a bowl of Froot Loops
entries.finding: A bowl of Raisin Bran has more sugar in it than a bowl of Froot Loops. 18 g against 12.

entries.title: Jet-Puffed marshmallows have blue dye in them
entries.finding: Jet-Puffed marshmallows have blue dye in them. That's how they come out white.

entries.title: The Impossible Burger is red because of a protein brewed by a genetically engineered yeast
entries.finding: The Impossible Burger is red because of a protein brewed by a genetically engineered yeast. The label calls it soy leghemoglobin.

entries.title: A Knorr chicken bouillon cube has no chicken in it
entries.finding: A Knorr chicken bouillon cube has no chicken in it. There's chicken fat, 8th on the list, behind 2 kinds of palm oil.

entries.title: Most chewing gum is plastic and rubber
entries.finding: Most chewing gum is plastic and rubber. The pack calls it gum base.

entries.title: The biggest supplier of apple juice to the United States is Turkey
entries.finding: The biggest supplier of apple juice to the United States is Turkey. The bottle tells you, in the smallest print on the label.

entries.title: Two products share the name soy sauce, and only one of them was brewed
entries.finding: Brewed soy sauce is soybeans, wheat and salt fermented for months. Non-brewed soy sauce is hydrolyzed soy protein, acid, caramel color and corn syrup made in a day.

entries.title: Costco blade tenderizes its steaks
entries.finding: Costco blade tenderizes its steaks. The label says so, and it's the reason a Costco steak comes with a cooking temperature printed on it.

entries.title: Mexican Coke is sweetened with sugar
entries.finding: Mexican Coke is sweetened with sugar. American Coke is sweetened with corn syrup.

entries.title: The shine on candy corn is bug resin
entries.finding: The shine on candy corn is bug resin. Brach's calls it confectioner's glaze.

entries.title: Canned tomatoes are peeled with lye
entries.finding: Canned tomatoes are peeled with lye. Most peeled tomatoes in a can went through a hot bath of sodium or potassium hydroxide at around 10% for under a minute, which dissolves the skin where it meets the flesh.

entries.title: Doritos and Tostitos come off the same line
entries.finding: Doritos and Tostitos come off the same line. Both start as corn cooked in lime and water, soaked overnight and ground into masa.

entries.title: One bottle of soy sauce spent 6 months in a tank
entries.finding: One bottle of soy sauce spent 6 months in a tank. The other was made in a day by boiling soy protein in hydrochloric acid and neutralizing it with lye.

entries.title: A can of 100% grated parmesan once had no parmesan in it
entries.finding: A can of 100% grated parmesan once had no parmesan in it. FDA found it in 2012 at Castle Cheese in Pennsylvania, which packed it for store brands including Always Save and Best Choice.

entries.title: Jiffy corn muffin mix is built around lard
entries.finding: Jiffy corn muffin mix is built around lard. Half the list is there to keep the lard from going bad.

entries.title: The citric acid in a Celsius is grown by a mold, and the taurine was never near a bull
entries.finding: The citric acid in a Celsius is grown by a mold, and the taurine was never near a bull. The list is carbonated water, citric acid, taurine, vegetable juice for color, guarana seed extract, green tea extract, caffeine, ascorbic acid, sucralose, glucuronolactone, ginger root extract and a vitamin pack.

entries.title: Chef Boyardee stretches the beef in its ravioli with soy dyed to match it
entries.finding: Chef Boyardee stretches the beef in its ravioli with soy dyed to match it. Read the can.

entries.title: Sysco handles about 18% of all the food Americans eat away from home
entries.finding: Sysco handles about 18% of all the food Americans eat away from home. They run 333 warehouses, about 19,000 trucks and about 670,000 customer locations, and 59% of sales are to restaurants.

entries.title: The protein number on your tub of whey is a nitrogen count
entries.finding: The protein number on your tub of whey is a nitrogen count. The lab digests the sample and measures the nitrogen.

entries.title: A serving of Campbell's tomato soup has more sugar than a Krispy Kreme glazed donut
entries.finding: A serving of Campbell's tomato soup has more sugar than a Krispy Kreme glazed donut. The can lists tomato puree, water, wheat flour and sugar, then under 2% of salt, potassium salt, natural flavoring, citric acid, vitamin C, celery extract and garlic oil.

entries.title: Heinz ketchup in the US is sweetened with corn syrup
entries.finding: Heinz ketchup in the US is sweetened with corn syrup. The same bottle in Britain is sweetened with sugar.

entries.title: Your sandwich bread stays soft for 2 weeks because of an enzyme
entries.finding: Your sandwich bread stays soft for 2 weeks because of an enzyme. The label either calls it enzymes or doesn't mention it at all.

entries.title: Ezekiel bread is made without flour
entries.finding: Ezekiel bread is made without flour. Food for Life soaks whole wheat, barley, millet, lentils, soybeans and spelt in water until they sprout, then mashes the wet sprouted grain into a dough, adds yeast and salt, and bakes it slow.

entries.title: Strawberry Fruit Roll-Ups have no strawberries in them
entries.finding: Strawberry Fruit Roll-Ups have no strawberries in them. Flip the box.

entries.title: The ingredient called hickory smoke flavor is wood smoke condensed into a liquid, minus the tar
entries.finding: The ingredient called hickory smoke flavor is wood smoke condensed into a liquid, minus the tar. The EU is phasing it out.

entries.title: Barilla is made in Iowa, and a court just said the flag never claimed otherwise
entries.finding: Barilla's US pasta is milled and extruded in Ames, Iowa and Avon, New York.

entries.title: Cap'N Crunch Berries have no berries in them
entries.finding: Cap'N Crunch Berries have no berries in them. The ingredient list is corn flour, sugar, oat flour, palm or coconut oil, salt and molasses, then Red 40, Yellow 5, Blue 1, Yellow 6 and natural and artificial flavor.

entries.title: Jack Link's Original is about $33 a pound
entries.finding: Jack Link's Original is about $33 a pound. That's more than ribeye.

entries.title: Mountain Dew has orange juice in it
entries.finding: Mountain Dew has orange juice in it. It's the third ingredient on the can, after carbonated water and high fructose corn syrup.

entries.title: A Tic Tac is mostly sugar, and the box says 0 calories and 0 carbohydrate
entries.finding: A Tic Tac is mostly sugar, and the box says 0 calories and 0 carbohydrate. Sugar is the first ingredient, then maltodextrin, rice starch, gum arabic, flavors, magnesium stearate and carnauba wax.

entries.title: American eggs are washed
entries.finding: American eggs are washed. European eggs aren't.

entries.title: Sweet Baby Ray's is corn syrup first
entries.finding: Sweet Baby Ray's is corn syrup first.

entries.title: A DiGiorno pepperoni pizza has about 40 ingredients
entries.finding: A DiGiorno pepperoni pizza has about 40 ingredients. A pepperoni pizza needs 8, flour, water, yeast, salt, olive oil, tomatoes, mozzarella and pepperoni.

entries.title: A Swiss Miss envelope is 72% sugar
entries.finding: A Swiss Miss envelope is 72% sugar. The Milk Chocolate packet weighs 39g and the label says 28g of it is sugar.

entries.title: Nearly every banana in the store was ripened in a gas room
entries.finding: Nearly every banana in the store was ripened in a gas room. They're cut green in Central and South America, long before they'd ripen on the plant, and shipped at 56 to 58F so they stay green.

entries.title: Less than half a scoop of Muscle Milk is protein
entries.finding: Less than half a scoop of Muscle Milk is protein. The serving on the Genuine tub is 2 scoops, 70g, and the label says 32g of protein.

entries.title: Prego has sugar as the third ingredient
entries.finding: Prego has sugar as the third ingredient. Rao's doesn't list sugar at all, and Campbell's owns both.

entries.title: Worcestershire sauce is a fish sauce
entries.finding: Worcestershire sauce is a fish sauce. The Lea & Perrins bottle reads distilled white vinegar, molasses, sugar, water, salt, onions, anchovies, garlic, cloves, tamarind extract, natural flavorings and chili pepper extract.

entries.title: Atlantic salmon at the store is farmed
entries.finding: Atlantic salmon at the store is farmed. Wild Atlantic salmon are endangered in the US and fishing for them is closed, and around the world wild ones are almost never sold, so if the label says Atlantic it came out of a net pen.

entries.title: The Texas Roadhouse honey cinnamon butter at the grocery store has no butter in it
entries.finding: The Texas Roadhouse honey cinnamon butter at the grocery store has no butter in it. The tub reads soybean oil, water, honey, palm oil, palm kernel oil, salt, cinnamon, soy lecithin, monoglycerides, pea protein, preservatives, natural flavors and beta carotene for color.

entries.title: The cheese sauce in Kraft Macaroni & Cheese doesn't list cheese
entries.finding: The cheese sauce in Kraft Macaroni & Cheese doesn't list cheese. The blue box packet is whey, milkfat, salt, milk protein concentrate and sodium triphosphate, then under 2% of starch, acids, paprika, turmeric and annatto for color, enzymes and cheese culture.

entries.title: Old fashioned oats are steamed before they're rolled
entries.finding: Old fashioned oats are steamed before they're rolled. A dry oat groat is hard, and rolling it without softening it first would crack it instead of flattening it.

entries.title: The juice in your peach fruit cup isn't peach juice
entries.finding: The juice in your peach fruit cup isn't peach juice. Dole and Del Monte both pack their peaches in 100% juice, and the juice is white grape juice from concentrate.

entries.title: Your apple can be coated with Apeel and the store doesn't have to tell you
entries.finding: Your apple can be coated with Apeel and the store doesn't have to tell you. It's mono and diglycerides, the same emulsifier that's in bread, made from plant oil, and you can't see it or taste it.

entries.title: Chicken noodle soup only has to be 2% chicken
entries.finding: Chicken noodle soup only has to be 2% chicken. That's the USDA minimum, and it works out to about 5 grams of cooked chicken in a cup of soup.

entries.title: Goya's Sazón with Saffron seasoning has no saffron in it
entries.finding: Goya's Sazón with Saffron seasoning has no saffron in it. Goya says it packs a powerful punch of saffron, but the ingredient on the box is Mexican saffron.

entries.title: Lemon Lime Gatorade has always had Yellow 5 in it
entries.finding: Lemon Lime Gatorade has always had Yellow 5 in it. The recall isn't about the dye being in the bottle.

entries.title: A slice of Dave's Killer Bread has more added sugar than a slice of Wonder Bread
entries.finding: A slice of Dave's Killer Bread has more added sugar than a slice of Wonder Bread. On the 21 Whole Grains and Seeds loaf the ingredients go organic whole wheat, water, organic cane sugar, then the grain and seed mix.

entries.title: Capri Sun is 15% juice and has mushroom extract
entries.finding: Capri Sun is 15% juice and has mushroom extract. The box says all natural ingredients, no high fructose corn syrup, no artificial colors, flavors or preservatives.

entries.title: Nutella is 13% hazelnuts, and that number is a supply decision
entries.finding: Nutella is 13% hazelnuts. Ferrero buys a quarter of the world's hazelnuts from one Turkish coastline.

entries.title: There's sugar in Morton table salt
entries.finding: There's sugar in Morton table salt. The ingredients on the iodized canister are salt, calcium silicate, dextrose and potassium iodide.

entries.title: Hawaiian Punch is 5% fruit juice
entries.finding: Hawaiian Punch is 5% fruit juice. It's printed in small type above the nutrition panel.

entries.title: Panko is bread baked with electricity
entries.finding: Panko is bread baked with electricity. Traditional panko makers run current through the dough between two metal plates, so the loaf cooks from the inside out and never forms a crust.

entries.title: Powdered sugar is about 3% cornstarch
entries.finding: Powdered sugar is about 3% cornstarch. Domino says so on its own site, and the box lists it as sugar and cornstarch.

entries.title: A 13 ounce jar of Nutella has about 40 hazelnuts in it
entries.finding: A 13 ounce jar of Nutella has about 40 hazelnuts in it. Every ingredient in that jar costs Ferrero about $1.

entries.title: Frosted Mini-Wheats aren't vegetarian
entries.finding: Frosted Mini-Wheats aren't vegetarian. The ingredients are whole grain wheat and sugar, then 2% or less of brown rice syrup and gelatin, plus iron and folic acid.

entries.title: Hood Pumpkin Eggnog gets its color from paprika
entries.finding: Hood Pumpkin Eggnog gets its color from paprika. The pumpkin is the sixth ingredient, behind the egg yolks, and the orange on the carton comes from paprika extract.

entries.title: Totino's Triple Cheese Party Pizza has three imitation cheeses on it
entries.finding: Totino's Triple Cheese Party Pizza has three imitation cheeses on it. The ingredient list names imitation mozzarella, imitation Monterey Jack and imitation cheddar.

entries.title: Ensure's biggest ingredient after water doesn't count as sugar on the label
entries.finding: Ensure's biggest ingredient after water doesn't count as sugar on the label. It's corn maltodextrin, then sugar, then milk protein concentrate, vegetable oil and soy protein.

entries.title: Slim Jim is made with mechanically separated chicken
entries.finding: Slim Jim is made with mechanically separated chicken. The ingredients are beef, pork, mechanically separated chicken, water and textured soy flour, then corn syrup and salt.

entries.title: Tater Tots were invented to use up the scraps from making french fries
entries.finding: Tater Tots were invented to use up the scraps from making french fries. In 1953 the brothers who started Ore-Ida were cutting fries in Ontario, Oregon, and the leftover slivers of potato were going to cattle feed.

entries.title: Daisy sour cream has one ingredient, cultured cream
entries.finding: Daisy sour cream has one ingredient, cultured cream. Plenty of store sour creams add milk, whey, starch, gums or preservatives on top of the cream.

entries.title: Jif doesn't separate because of fully hydrogenated oil
entries.finding: Jif doesn't separate because of fully hydrogenated oil. Natural peanut butter is usually just ground peanuts and salt, and the peanut oil rises to the top because the ground peanuts are heavier.

entries.title: Land O Lakes Fat Free Half & Half is mostly skim milk and corn syrup
entries.finding: Land O Lakes Fat Free Half & Half is mostly skim milk and corn syrup. The carton lists skim milk, corn syrup and cream, then 0.5% or less of carrageenan, sodium citrate, dipotassium phosphate, mono and diglycerides, vitamin A palmitate and color added.

entries.title: Spam is cooked inside the can
entries.finding: Spam is cooked inside the can. The raw meat mixture goes into the can and the can is sealed.

entries.title: The pasta labeled bronze cut is rough on purpose
entries.finding: The pasta labeled bronze cut is rough on purpose. Dry pasta is made by pushing dough through a metal plate with the shape cut into it, called a die.

entries.title: The raw almonds at the store have been pasteurized
entries.finding: The raw almonds at the store have been pasteurized. Since 2007, almonds grown in California have to be treated to kill salmonella before they're sold in the US, Canada or Mexico, and that includes the bags labeled raw.

entries.title: Costco built its own chicken company to protect the $4.99 rotisserie chicken
entries.finding: Costco built its own chicken company to protect the $4.99 rotisserie chicken. It's called Lincoln Premium Poultry, it's in Fremont, Nebraska, and it opened in 2019 with its own hatchery, feed mill and processing plant.

entries.title: The Philadelphia in the tub isn't cream cheese
entries.finding: The Philadelphia in the tub isn't cream cheese. The lid says cream cheese spread.

entries.title: Top Ramen noodles are fried before they go in the bag
entries.finding: Top Ramen noodles are fried before they go in the bag. The list starts with enriched flour and palm oil, then salt, and TBHQ is near the end.

entries.title: Coffee-mate Original has no cream in it
entries.finding: Coffee-mate Original has no cream in it. The bottle is water, corn syrup solids and soybean oil, and the only dairy is micellar casein, a milk protein, in the under 2% group.

entries.title: The butter on your movie theater popcorn isn't butter
entries.finding: The butter on your movie theater popcorn isn't butter. At most theaters the pump is filled with buttery topping, which is soybean oil, artificial butter flavor and beta carotene, the same pigment that makes carrots orange.

entries.title: Vanilla ice cream has three legal names
entries.finding: Vanilla ice cream has three legal names. The difference is a word or two on the front of the carton.

entries.title: Duke's mayonnaise has no sugar in it, and Hellmann's and Kraft both do
entries.finding: Duke's mayonnaise has no sugar in it, and Hellmann's and Kraft both do. Duke's lists soybean oil, eggs, water, distilled and cider vinegar, salt, oleoresin paprika, natural flavors and calcium disodium EDTA.

entries.title: Rewashing bagged salad at home doesn't make it any safer
entries.finding: Rewashing bagged salad at home doesn't make it any safer. FDA says produce labeled pre-washed or ready to eat can be used without washing it again.

entries.title: The brown sugar at the grocery store is usually white sugar with molasses added back
entries.finding: The brown sugar at the grocery store is usually white sugar with molasses added back. Light brown is about 3.5% molasses.

entries.title: About a quarter of the saffron sold worldwide is fake or cut with something else
entries.finding: About a quarter of the saffron sold worldwide is fake or cut with something else. Each crocus flower gives three threads and they're picked by hand, so real saffron is expensive and worth faking.

entries.title: Nature's Own says no artificial preservatives, but there's a preservative in it
entries.finding: Nature's Own says no artificial preservatives, but there's a preservative in it. The 100% Whole Wheat loaf lists it as cultured wheat flour.

entries.title: Your box of Honey Maid has more white flour in it than graham flour
entries.finding: Your box of Honey Maid has more white flour in it than graham flour. The first ingredient is unbleached enriched flour.

entries.title: Your strawberry Twizzlers have no licorice in them
entries.finding: Your strawberry Twizzlers have no licorice in them. The list is corn syrup, wheat flour, sugar and cornstarch, then palm oil, salt, artificial flavor, citric acid, mineral oil, Red 40 and soy lecithin at 2% or less.

entries.title: Bagged shredded cheese is coated in powder so it won't clump, and that powder gets in the way when you melt it
entries.finding: Bagged shredded cheese is coated in powder so it won't clump, and that powder gets in the way when you melt it. Look at Kroger's sharp cheddar.

entries.title: The cinnamon in your cabinet is almost certainly cassia, which is a different plant
entries.finding: The cinnamon in your cabinet is almost certainly cassia, which is a different plant. Real cinnamon, the kind sold as Ceylon or true cinnamon, comes from Cinnamomum verum and it's grown mostly in Sri Lanka.

entries.title: Your uncured bacon is cured
entries.finding: Your uncured bacon is cured. Pick up a pack and find the line that says no nitrates or nitrites added except those naturally occurring in celery powder.

entries.title: American butter is legally required to be at least 80% milkfat
entries.finding: American butter is legally required to be at least 80% milkfat. That number comes from an act of Congress in 1923.

entries.title: Coffee-mate costs less to make than half-and-half
entries.finding: There is no cream in Coffee-mate. The bottle is water, corn syrup solids and soybean oil.

entries.title: Fairlife chocolate protein shake has one main ingredient
entries.finding: Fairlife chocolate protein shake has one main ingredient. Filtered lowfat milk.

entries.title: The 100% parmesan had no parmesan in it
entries.finding: FDA found no parmesan in a cheese labeled 100% parmesan. The inspection of Castle Cheese ended in a guilty plea.

entries.title: The Philadelphia in the tub isn't cream cheese
entries.finding: Cream cheese has a federal standard: at least 33% milkfat, no more than 55% moisture. Cream cheese spread has none.

entries.title: The pumpkin costs 6 cents. The can costs 19.
entries.finding: Canned pumpkin is really a squash from one corner of Illinois, packed in about 6 weeks.

entries.title: Triple washed salad is washed in chlorinated water
entries.finding: Bagged greens are washed in chlorine that mainly protects the wash water.

entries.title: Wholly Guacamole has no preservatives in it and it sits in the case for weeks
entries.finding: Wholly Guacamole has no preservatives in it and it sits in the case for weeks. Here is how.

entries.title: Your cinnamon is almost certainly cassia
entries.finding: US labels need not say which tree your cinnamon came from. Almost certainly cassia, a different plant than true cinnamon (Cinnamomum verum).

entries.title: A Twinkie is made with beef fat
entries.finding: A Twinkie is made with beef fat. Tallow is the fifth ingredient.

entries.title: Canned black olives are green olives
entries.finding: Canned black olives are green olives. They get picked green and turned black at the plant.

entries.title: Whole milk has had cream taken out of it
entries.finding: Whole milk has had cream taken out of it. A cow gives milk at 3.5 to 5% fat.

entries.title: A can of PAM olive oil spray says 0 calories and 0 grams of fat
entries.finding: A can of PAM olive oil spray says 0 calories and 0 grams of fat. The ingredients are extra virgin olive oil, soy lecithin and dimethyl silicone.

entries.title: Tonic water is a soft drink
entries.finding: Tonic water is a soft drink. A serving has 16 grams of added sugar in it, which the panel puts at 33% of your day.

entries.title: Your can of pumpkin puree is squash
entries.finding: Your can of pumpkin puree is squash. Libby's grows and cans a tan, oblong variety from the butternut family and labels it 100% pure pumpkin.

entries.title: A 13 oz bag of Buc-ee's Beaver Nuggets holds 180 grams of added sugar
entries.finding: A 13 oz bag of Buc-ee's Beaver Nuggets holds 180 grams of added sugar. The panel says 15g per serving and 12 servings per bag, and it lists all 15g as added sugar.

entries.title: David's protein milkshake has 2 grams of fat in it and tastes like a milkshake
entries.finding: David's protein milkshake has 2 grams of fat in it and tastes like a milkshake. The fat is one ingredient, EPG, and your body mostly doesn't absorb it.

entries.title: There is no maple in Mrs. Butterworth's
entries.finding: There is no maple in Mrs. Butterworth's. The ingredient list is high fructose corn syrup, corn syrup, water, and under 2% of cellulose gum, salt, molasses, natural and artificial flavor, caramel color, and preservatives.

entries.title: There's less than 2% cream in Cool Whip according to the ingredient list
entries.finding: There's less than 2% cream in Cool Whip according to the ingredient list. The list says water, corn syrup, high fructose corn syrup, hydrogenated vegetable oil, skim milk, and then the under 2% ingredients, starting with light cream.

entries.title: A bottle that says imported from Italy on the front will often list Spain, Greece and Tunisia on the back
entries.finding: Turn an olive oil bottle around and find the smallest print on the back, near the bottom. That's the country of origin.

entries.title: The first two ingredients in Hidden Valley Ranch are vegetable oil and water
entries.finding: The first two ingredients in Hidden Valley Ranch are vegetable oil and water. Buttermilk is third, sugar is fourth.

entries.title: Your pickles were never fermented
entries.finding: Your pickles were never fermented. Look at a jar of Vlasic dill spears.

entries.title: Potassium bromate makes dough stronger and rise higher
entries.finding: Potassium bromate makes dough stronger and rise higher. It's been banned in the EU and UK since 1990, Canada since 1994, China since 2005, and more than two dozen countries in total.

entries.title: Pringles are 42% potato
entries.finding: Pringles are 42% potato. That number comes from P&G's own lawyers, in a British court case where they argued their product was not a potato crisp.

entries.title: The name San Marzano has no legal protection in the United States
entries.finding: The name San Marzano has no legal protection in the United States. In Italy the tomato has a DOP, a protected designation, which means it has to be grown in a specific area near Naples, canned whole peeled or in fillets, and certified by a consortium that puts a numbered seal on the can.

entries.title: Athenos is the biggest feta brand in America and it's made from cow's milk
entries.finding: Athenos is the biggest feta brand in America and it's made from cow's milk. The ingredient list is cultured pasteurized part skim milk, salt, enzymes.

entries.title: Häagen-Dazs isn't Danish
entries.finding: Häagen-Dazs isn't Danish. It isn't a word in Danish or any other language.

entries.title: SunnyD is 5% juice
entries.finding: SunnyD is 5% juice. The first two ingredients are water and high fructose corn syrup.

entries.title: Eggo Chocolatey Chip waffles can't be called chocolate chip waffles
entries.finding: Eggo Chocolatey Chip waffles can't be called chocolate chip waffles. Chocolate has a federal standard.

entries.title: Every retail bottle of Kikkoman sold in the US is brewed in Walworth, Wisconsin
entries.finding: Every retail bottle of Kikkoman sold in the US is brewed in Walworth, Wisconsin. Has been since 1973.

entries.title: If an ingredient list says carmine, cochineal extract, or Natural Red 4, that's an insect
entries.finding: If an ingredient list says carmine, cochineal extract, or Natural Red 4, that's an insect. A scale insect farmed on cactus, mostly in Peru, dried and crushed.

entries.title: Cadbury in the US is made by Hershey
entries.finding: Cadbury in the US is made by Hershey. It has been since 1988, under license, with Hershey's own recipe.

entries.title: Honey Nut Cheerios has more sugar than honey
entries.finding: Honey Nut Cheerios has more sugar than honey. Sugar is the second ingredient, honey is further down, and there's brown sugar syrup after that.

entries.title: The Gerber pouch that says Apple Blueberry Spinach on the front has half a spinach leaf in it
entries.finding: The Gerber pouch that says Apple Blueberry Spinach on the front has half a spinach leaf in it. Gerber says the product contains 1/2 an apple, 16 blueberries, 1/2 a spinach leaf.

entries.title: Almost every store brand infant formula in America is made by one company, Perrigo, at a plant in Vermont
entries.finding: Almost every store brand infant formula in America is made by one company, Perrigo, at a plant in Vermont. Kirkland, Parent's Choice, Sam's, Target, most of the grocery chains.

entries.title: Fanta Orange was created in Italy in 1955 and in Italy it has orange juice in it
entries.finding: Fanta Orange was created in Italy in 1955 and in Italy it has orange juice in it. In the US it has none.

entries.title: Land O Lakes Light Butter with Canola Oil lists water as the first ingredient
entries.finding: Land O Lakes Light Butter with Canola Oil lists water as the first ingredient.

entries.title: Chipotle's barbacoa and carnitas have never been cooked in the restaurant
entries.finding: Chipotle's barbacoa and carnitas have never been cooked in the restaurant. They're cooked sous vide in a central kitchen, sealed in bags and shipped to the stores on refrigerated trucks.

entries.title: Gatorade used to have brominated vegetable oil in it, BVO, which is patented as a flame retardant and was banned in Europe and Japan
entries.finding: Gatorade used to have brominated vegetable oil in it, BVO, which is patented as a flame retardant and was banned in Europe and Japan. A 15 year old named Sarah Kavanagh read the label in 2012, looked it up, and started a petition that got 200,000 signatures.

entries.title: Strawberry Pop-Tarts are 2% or less strawberries
entries.finding: Strawberry Pop-Tarts are 2% or less strawberries. That's the label, dried strawberries are in the 2% or less group along with dried pears and dried apples.

entries.title: Double Stuf Oreos aren't double stuffed
entries.finding: Double Stuf Oreos aren't double stuffed. A high school math teacher in Queensbury, New York had his class weigh 10 of each kind, then weigh the plain wafers separately and subtract them out.

entries.title: Nutella is 13% hazelnuts
entries.finding: Nutella is 13% hazelnuts. The first two ingredients are sugar and palm oil and together they're more than half the jar.

entries.title: Ocean Spray Cranberry Juice Cocktail is 27% juice
entries.finding: Ocean Spray Cranberry Juice Cocktail is 27% juice. It says so on the back in small print because FDA makes them put it there.

entries.title: In 2016 Mars said it would take all artificial colors out of M&Ms, Skittles and everything else it makes within five years
entries.finding: In 2016 Mars said it would take all artificial colors out of M&Ms, Skittles and everything else it makes within five years. They repeated it in 2019.

entries.title: Most of the food brands you think of as small companies don't own a factory
entries.finding: Most of the food brands you think of as small companies don't own a factory. They use a co-packer, which is a plant that makes product for 20 or 30 brands on the same equipment.

entries.title: Tillamook cheese mostly isn't made in Tillamook
entries.finding: Tillamook cheese mostly isn't made in Tillamook. The company's big plant is in Boardman, Oregon, 230 miles east in the desert, and it turns out around 170 million pounds of cheese a year.

entries.title: Costco's store brand did about $86 billion last year
entries.finding: Costco's store brand did about $86 billion last year. That's more than Coca-Cola, more than Nike, and roughly tied with Procter & Gamble, and it comes from about 550 products with zero advertising.

entries.title: Every chopped or ground deli item is there to use something that couldn't be sold whole
entries.finding: Every chopped or ground deli item is there to use something that couldn't be sold whole. Chicken salad gets the trim, the breasts that came out torn or too small, and the rotisserie that timed out in the warmer.

entries.title: If your Sriracha has tasted different the last few years, there's a reason and it isn't drought
entries.finding: If your Sriracha has tasted different the last few years, there's a reason and it isn't drought. For 28 years Huy Fong bought every red jalapeno it used from one farm, Underwood Ranches in Ventura County.

entries.title: Reduced Fat Jif isn't peanut butter
entries.finding: Reduced Fat Jif isn't peanut butter. Look at the jar, it says Peanut Butter Spread, 60% Peanuts, because FDA requires anything called peanut butter to be at least 90% peanuts.

entries.title: Barilla pasta sold in the US is made in Ames, Iowa and Avon, New York
entries.finding: Barilla pasta sold in the US is made in Ames, Iowa and Avon, New York. Has been since 1998.

entries.title: General Mills did the opposite of Kraft and it blew up in their face
entries.finding: General Mills did the opposite of Kraft and it blew up in their face. In 2016 they took the artificial dyes out of Trix and announced it.

entries.title: Oatly has no sugar in the ingredient list and 7 grams of added sugar on the nutrition panel
entries.finding: Oatly has no sugar in the ingredient list and 7 grams of added sugar on the nutrition panel. Both are true.

entries.title: The soy sauce packet in your takeout bag isn't soy sauce
entries.finding: The soy sauce packet in your takeout bag isn't soy sauce. The biggest maker, Kari-Out in New Jersey, lists water, salt, hydrolyzed soy and corn protein, caramel color and sodium benzoate.

entries.title: In 2015, General Mills tried to recreate the White Shark without Titanium Dioxide and couldn’t
entries.finding: In 2015, General Mills tried to recreate the White Shark without Titanium Dioxide and couldn’t. That killed the line.

entries.title: Most Dunkin' locations don't make their own donuts anymore
entries.finding: Most Dunkin' locations don't make their own donuts anymore. Franchisees can bake in store, get a daily delivery from a regional kitchen that fries them overnight, or buy them frozen and finish them in a warmer.

entries.title: Trader Joe's won't say who makes their products and the suppliers sign agreements not to say either
entries.finding: Trader Joe's won't say who makes their products and the suppliers sign agreements not to say either. The way reporters figured it out was recalls.

entries.title: USDA lets poultry be labeled fresh as long as it never goes below 26 degrees
entries.finding: USDA lets poultry be labeled fresh as long as it never goes below 26 degrees. Water freezes at 32, so a chicken can be frozen solid at 27 and still sold as fresh.

entries.title: Girl Scout cookies come from two different bakeries with two different recipes, and your zip code decides which one you get
entries.finding: Girl Scout cookies come from two different bakeries with two different recipes, and your zip code decides which one you get. Every council picks either ABC Bakers or Little Brownie Bakers.

entries.title: Kraft removed the artificial dyes from Mac & Cheese in Dec 2015 but didn't tell anyone until March
entries.finding: Kraft removed the artificial dyes from Mac & Cheese in Dec 2015 but didn't tell anyone until March. They swapped Yellow 5 and 6 for paprika, annatto and turmeric and kept shipping the same blue box with a new ingredient list.

entries.title: The breast is where the money is
entries.finding: The breast is where the money is. Americans want white meat, so a bird gets cut up and the breasts go out at $3 to $4 a pound, wings at $3 or more, thighs somewhere in between.

entries.title: Two of India's biggest spice brands, MDH and Everest, got pulled off shelves in 2024 for ethylene oxide
entries.finding: Two of India's biggest spice brands, MDH and Everest, got pulled off shelves in 2024 for ethylene oxide, a carcinogen used to fumigate spices.

entries.title: Aquafina and Dasani are tap water
entries.finding: Aquafina and Dasani are tap water. Aquafina bottles carried the letters P.W.S.

entries.title: Bac-Os have never contained bacon
entries.finding: Bac-Os have never contained bacon. The ingredients are soy flour, soybean oil, salt, and flavoring, dyed to look like bacon crumbles.

entries.title: Honey. Salt. Sugar. White rice. Dried beans. Vinegar. Anything over 40 proof
entries.finding: Honey. Salt. Sugar. White rice. Dried beans. Vinegar. Anything over 40 proof. Brown rice has natural oils and will spoil.

entries.title: Miracle Whip has never been mayonnaise
entries.finding: Miracle Whip has never been mayonnaise. It legally can't be.

entries.title: A 5 ounce can of tuna holds about 3.5 ounces of tuna
entries.finding: A 5 ounce can of tuna holds about 3.5 ounces of tuna. The number on the label is the fish and packing liquid together.

entries.title: Costco has sold the hot dog and soda combo for $1.50 since 1985
entries.finding: Costco has sold the hot dog and soda combo for $1.50 since 1985. It has never gone up.

entries.title: FDA keeps a red list of honey companies
entries.finding: FDA keeps a red list of honey companies. Their shipments get held at the border.

entries.title: I once looked at buying an old waffle factory
entries.finding: I walked in and there were hundreds of waffles still sitting there, and they looked perfect. No mold. Nothing.

entries.title: It isn't preserved. It's jerky.
entries.finding: A McDonald's patty is thin, salted, and cooked hot, so it's mostly dry the second it leaves the grill. Leave either one on a counter and it dehydrates before anything can grow.

entries.title: Poland doesn't farm Atlantic salmon
entries.finding: Poland doesn't farm Atlantic salmon. This fish was almost certainly raised in Norway, shipped to Poland, smoked and packed there, and shipped again.
